rationale: All four lenses and the standards audit ran; every story/spec criterion passes or is a declared non-goal, with lint/typecheck/test execution pending Stage 7. 1 deferred (pre-existing: tool-fields.ts and session-signals.ts still gate Write counting on different types, so a Write with no type or an update with no structuredPatch diverges as on origin/main) -> code-review-deferred.local.md. 4 dismissed: a hypothetical create with a non-empty hunk-less patch, a stale doc reference, a test comment, and a test gap for the deferred shape.
